title: PLC digital I/O wiring
goal: A reader must be able to trace four field inputs and four outputs between numbered terminals, the PLC, and the 24 VDC supply.

rubric.must: A PLC labelled with four digital input points and four digital output points is visible.
A numbered field I/O terminal block is visible between the PLC and field devices.
START, STOP, and RESET pushbuttons plus a proximity sensor are visibly shown on the input side.
Two control relays, a solenoid valve, and an output pilot are visibly shown on the output side.
A 24 VDC supply and a clearly labelled 2 A PLC I/O fuse are visible.
Separate DI common return and DO common plus-24V wiring labels are visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Field devices on the left, PLC in the middle, output devices on the right, each crossing a numbered terminal; the +24 V feed and the 0 V return are drawn in different colours and both commons are wired. A note explains that one terminal block is shown in two sections.
